## Attendance

The February 2021 programme board was chaired by J. Whitfield.

Attendees: J. Whitfield, S. Rahman, Priya Anand, R. Adeyemi, G. Evans.

The board confirmed the attendance recorded for the meeting and proceeded with the review of performance, current items and follow-up actions.

## Performance

The board reviewed activity and noted 1268 captures for February 2021. This provided the basis for the discussion of outstanding work and correspondence.

The backlog was recorded as 117. The board also noted 1 letter breach. Members considered these figures alongside the operational position and agreed that they should continue to be monitored through the programme’s routine reporting.

## Items

The triage pilot with ClearSight Diagnostics started at Harbour Eye Clinic. Nobody has signed the hazard log as clinical safety owner; the chair accepted the risk for the pilot period.

The board noted the governance position and the need for the outstanding safety ownership matter to remain visible during the pilot period.

## Actions

The chair will circulate actions arising from the meeting. The circulated actions will support continued monitoring of performance and the pilot’s governance position.
